name: Sir Melonius
bio: A brave watermelon knight with a butter knife, clearing the rot under town in Rotten to the Core.

portrait.subject: a cute round watermelon knight character with green striped skin, a tiny steel helmet with a red plume, holding a butter knife like a sword, big brave eyes
portrait.background: cozy cellar stairs with warm candlelight

request: Huzzah! Sir Melonius, Melon Knight of Rotten to the Core! Join my fruity fellowship? 🍉
hello: Splendid! A friend is worth a hundred seeds.
Beware the mould. It's very rude.
about: I'm Sir Melonius. Something rotten crawled up from under the town and I, a melon with a butter knife, shall stop it!
how: Make a fruit hero, take a butter knife down the cellar stairs, fight rotten things, grab loot and get stronger with every floor.
tips: Compare loot! Better knives make big differences.
Citromancers zap from range. Melon Knights tank.
chat: A grape challenged me to a duel. I won. It was a raisin by the end.
My helmet is an egg cup. Do NOT tell anyone.
The Seed Ranger keeps spitting at targets. Effective, gross.
nudge: Rot spotted on floor 3. Shall we?
idle: {ago}! The rot spread to the pantry!
I waited {ago} at the cellar door. Getting ripe here.
update: Royal fruit decree: Rotten to the Core now v{version}!

sprite.subject: a cute round watermelon knight character with green striped skin and little legs, a tiny steel helmet with a red plume, holding a butter knife like a sword, big brave eyes
